Your records start on this device
Weighing and manual food entry need no account or AI key. Health sync, online recognition and app updates connect to external services for their respective features.

Weights, meals, device information, your food library and drafts are saved locally. ScaleMate has no account system, ads, location tracking, analytics or its own cloud sync. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes local records.
Bluetooth access is for your scale

Nearby device access discovers scales and receives weight readings. ScaleMate scans only while the app is in the foreground. It does not request location access or track your location. Bluetooth weighing does not use AI.
Separate permissions for weight and nutrition

Records are saved locally first, then written to Health Connect according to your permissions: weight and measurement time, or meal names, meal times and nutrition totals. Whether Google Fit or another app displays them depends on its read permissions and support. Revoking access stops future writes; it does not delete records already written.

When you start an analysis, your selected food images, diner count, tags and description are sent to the AI service you selected. Its data use is explained and consent requested before first use. Images are compressed and EXIF location metadata removed; anything visible in the image is still sent. Provider fees and data retention and usage policies apply.

API keys are stored locally with Android Keystore encryption. Public endpoints use HTTPS. If you configure a private-network HTTP endpoint, request content and authentication keys travel unencrypted. Connection tests send only test text, not food photos or health records.

Update checks, downloads and route speed tests contact GitHub or download proxies. Those services can see your IP address and request paths. These requests do not include weights, meals, photos or AI keys. Automatic checks and downloads can be turned off in Software updates.

Manage write permissions in Health Connect, and edit or delete service configurations in AI settings. When deleting a record, choose local deletion or also remove the record ScaleMate wrote to Health Connect. Copies already imported by other apps must be managed in those apps.

Health analysis reads only the categories you select and allow in Health Connect. It uses that Health Connect data rather than unsent local meals, weights or drafts. A summary and your confirmed goals are sent to the chosen AI service only after separate consent. Local reminders do not call AI or upload a summary in the background.

Snapshots, reports, conversations and reminder history stay in app-private storage and can be deleted in Health. Raw read details expire after 24 hours. If you explicitly export or share files or copy a prompt, you choose the recipient; saved or shared copies are not withdrawn when app history is deleted. Reading health data and exporting do not require an AI key.

Third-party routes only transport GitHub Release files. Every download is checked against the signed manifest before installation. They have no SLA and may stop working.
